codeReview.summary: The fix adequately addresses all three issues from the original scrutiny review. The redundant scene_version parameter was removed from run_migrations(), which now imports SCENE_VERSION directly and compares scene.version against it for the forward compatibility check. The migration loop was enhanced with an early-break guard to stop once scene.version >= SCENE_VERSION, preventing over-migration. A v0->v1 migration stub was added to enable the pipeline to exercise a real migration path. All tests were updated to use the new single-parameter signature and realistic version values. All 7 migration tests pass, workspace tests pass, and clippy is clean.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker discovered during implementation that when multiple migrations exist in the registry (v0->v1, v1->v2) and SCENE_VERSION is 1, the migration loop would over-migrate (applying v1->v2 after v0->v1) without an early-break guard. This is a general lesson about migration loop design that could be documented for future migration work.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript shows the worker encountered a test failure where scene.version ended up at 2 instead of 1, leading to the addition of the early-break guard `if scene.version >= SCENE_VERSION { break; }` inside the migration loop.

summary: The fix fully resolves the blocking bug from the original scrutiny review. The dead code in run_migrations() forward compatibility check has been eliminated by removing the redundant scene_version parameter and comparing scene.version directly against SCENE_VERSION. The two non-blocking test issues (test_migration_runs_on_mismatch testing a no-op scenario, test_migration_bumps_version using artificial version values) have also been addressed — the former now tests a realistic same-version no-op, and the latter exercises the real v0->v1 migration path thanks to the new MigrateV0ToV1 stub. The early-break guard in the migration loop is a bonus improvement that prevents over-migration when multiple registered migrations exist beyond SCENE_VERSION. All verification steps pass.
